title: ProjectBindingV1
description: project_binding.v1 — the typed contract a project/sibling presents so the mesh authority treats it as DATA instead of a compiled ProjectRegistryEntry literal (PLAN.md principle 1). Grep-verified generic across nhl(G04), winwar(G13), qedviz(NO goal), sitelayer(NO goal) and external siblings (no mesh goal): see MAXIMAL-BREAKDOWN §5 ledger row 3. The TypeScript interface in src/project-binding.ts is kept field-for-field in sync with this schema. additionalProperties:false makes field drift a structural validation failure: a new field must be added HERE first. ONLY project_key is required — goal_anchor is OPTIONAL + opaque so projects with no mesh goal (qedviz, external siblings) still validate.

project_key.description: Stable shared project key (e.g. nhl, winwar, qedviz, sitelayer). The authority's primary identity. Open string, NOT a closed roster union.

goal_anchor.description: OPTIONAL + OPAQUE mesh GoalID (e.g. G04 for nhl, G13 for winwar). LOAD-BEARING: qedviz has no GoalID and external siblings have no mesh goal, so this is never required and never a closed enum of known goal ids. The authority resolves the anchor internally.

display_name.description: Human-facing label (e.g. Sitelayer, Hockeypedia). Maps to OperatorProjectEventSurface.display_name.

description.description: Longer free-form description. Maps to ProjectRegistryEntry.Description.

git_remote_url.description: Canonical git remote. Maps to ProjectRegistryEntry.GitRemoteURL. Optional (winwar registers without one). Opaque to the authority.

git_default_branch.description: Default branch of git_remote_url. FREE STRING (chess=master, most=main) — never a closed union. Maps to ProjectRegistryEntry.GitDefaultBranch.

repo_names.description: Repository slugs that belong to this project (a project may span several). Maps to OperatorProjectEventSurface.repo_names. Opaque — no monorepo/workspace structure inferred.

production_hosts.description: Production hostnames the project serves. Maps to OperatorProjectEventSurface.production_hosts. May be empty for projects with no public surface.

url_patterns.description: URL patterns that auto-bind a captured/narrated page to this project (project_url_resolver.go ResolveProjectFromURL). Maps to projects.url_patterns (mesh migration 294/295). Empty = no auto-binding.
